question: Looking at DHL Group's consolidated net debt at each year-end from 2020 through 2025, at which year-end was it lowest, and what was the figure (in € million) and the next-lowest year-end?

Did DHL Group reach its own forecast for free cash flow including acquisitions and divestitures in fiscal year 2025, as published on March 5, 2025? Compare target and result, and say whether the target for free cash flow excluding acquisitions and divestitures was reached.

Rank the three asset classes with the largest risk-weighted assets (RWA) under Luzerner Kantonalbank's standardised approach for credit risk at 31 December 2025, considering the main asset classes only (not the 'of which' sub-lines), and give the RWA of each in CHF million.

Compare the leverage ratio of ASN Bank at 31 December 2025 with that of Commonwealth Bank of Australia (Europe) N.V. at 30 June 2025, both as reported in their Pillar 3 key metrics. Which was higher and by how many percentage points?

ASN Bank's credit risk exposure amount at 31 December 2025 includes an Article 3 CRR add-on of € 1,879 million for pending IRB model refinements on non-NHG mortgages. Purely as a mechanical recomputation, what would ASN Bank's CET1 ratio be at 31 December 2025 if that add-on were removed from the total risk exposure amount and CET1 capital stayed unchanged? Round to two decimals.

Of the international-standard gold owned by the Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye itself (excluding gold held for banks' reserve requirements, free gold deposits of banks and Treasury gold) at 31 December 2025, at which custodian location was the largest amount held, and what was its value in TRY?
What drove the ECB's write-downs on financial assets and positions of EUR 1,446 million in 2025, according to the notes to its financial statements?
According to Prudential International Assurance plc's 2025 sensitivity analysis, what would be the impact on its SCR coverage ratio, Own Funds, SCR and surplus of a 25% fall in equities?
Was Fresenius Group's EBIT margin before special items higher in 2025 than in 2024 (consolidated, excluding the discontinued Fresenius Vamed operations)?
How did the total expense ratio (TER) of Class I USD Accumulating of the GFI Fund sub-fund of Guggenheim Global Investments plc move from the financial year 2024 to the financial year 2025?
